title: Train a word HMM with Baum-Welch
brief: Run the backward pass, re-estimate an HMM with one Baum-Welch step that never lowers the likelihood, and train and compare one model per word.
hints: backward mirrors forward: log_A + (log_B[t + 1] + log_beta[t + 1])[None, :], then logsumexp over axis=1, the 'to' states.
gamma = exp(log_alpha + log_beta - log_p). The transition counts sum exp(log_xi) over t = 0 .. T - 2, and so does the denominator.
Accumulate every sum over all sequences before dividing; return the log-likelihood you computed with the parameters that came in.
train_word_hmm calls flat_start once, then baum_welch_step in a loop, and records the log-likelihood each step returns.
recognize scores X under every model with forward and returns the name with the highest log-likelihood.
